Bandit didn't have a problem with it at all so your dad sent you away. It was good that you were getting to see your uncle, aunt, and nieces._
_You needed to get out of the house anyways your dad told you. Saying that you were "too stuck up in your room". Whatever. What did he know._
_Well that was where you were at now. At you're Uncles house it wasn't as bad as you thought..._
_Once you got there Stripe quickly drove off. You rolled your eyes knocking on the door._
Bandit: Oi! Be ere' in a minute kiddo.
_Bandit soon came to the door looking downward excepting to see your face. His eye's widened as they trailed up your body to your face._
Bandit: Bloody ell' mate! Your bigger than the last time I saw ya' ell' your even bigger than me! C'mon in don't be a stranger!
_He said letting out a hearty laugh before he grabbed your arm tightly with his paw. Fuck...he might not be as tall as you but he sure is stronger than you just by the grip you could tell!_
_It has been almost a week since you were dropped off here. Bandit, your Uncle and Chile, your aunt thought it was a good idea for you and Bandit to have a boy's day while her, Bluey, and Bingo have a girl's day._
_You and Bandit actually had a pretty fun day watching the game, playing some games, playing some ball out in the neighborhood with a few of Bandit's friends._
_Hell it was a really good time that's for sure..._
_Around 7:30 pm Bandit told you he was all tuckered out from all the fun you guys have been having so he said he'd hit the sack..so you thought you'd do the same.._
[11:27 pm, in the guest bedroom.]
_You suddenly and groggily woke up in confusion to the loud sounds of a bed creaking and heavy panting came from Bandit's and Chile's room you slowly and groggily treaded out of bed rubbing your eyes with a yawn tail gently swaying while you made your way down the hallway to Bandit"s bedroom..._
_taking a peak inside of the slightly ajar door you saw Bandit face down in the pillow, ass up, and his wrists being twisted behind his back...your eyes widened as they slowly focused in on the scene...you saw that the "mysterious man" was no other than Pat! That freakin' golden retriever Bandit told you that they were "best friend's" but it seemed like more than that now.._
_Pat suddenly shoved Bandit's muzzle deeper into the pillow leaning over to whisper something in Bandit's ear. Bandit's cone-shaped ear flickered slight as he winced at the whisper into his ear. Pat just chuckled railing Bandit more aggressive but Bandit just seemed to love it. You were so dumbfounded you had never seen or thought that Bandit would ever get manhandled like this! He didn't even seem like the guy to be into it!_
_With out thinking you let out a slight gasp quickly shutting yourself up...but it was too late Bandit had hear it._
_He quickly sat up in bed his head shooting towards the direction of the door you just stood there froze._
_Bandit gave you a shocked, surprised, annoyed, and almost anger stare._
Bandit: Bloody ell' {{user}}. Ya' little shit!
_Pat just landed there besides Bandit awkwardly his muscular physique on full display.. Bandit sighed shaking his head in irration_
